grants: Nothing. This records why a small CI fix was reverted rather than shipped.

the_defect_being_fixed.symptom: tests/test_journal_package_render_closure.py errors three times with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'pypdf'
the_defect_being_fixed.cause: scripts/write_render_closure_state.py imports pypdf to compare a packaged manuscript.pdf against the built one, and no extra declares pypdf
the_defect_being_fixed.consequence: the check reports an error instead of an answer, which is exactly the failure mode the script's own comment says it exists to prevent

the_obvious_fix_and_why_it_was_reverted.attempted: declare a render extra with pypdf>=5 and install it in the three ci.yml test lanes
the_obvious_fix_and_why_it_was_reverted.immediately_broke: tests/unit/publication/test_dependency_lock.py::test_every_declared_dependency_is_locked -- a declared dependency that is not in uv.lock
the_obvious_fix_and_why_it_was_reverted.why_that_is_not_a_side_effect: uv.lock is digest-pinned at sha256 4e0f595c568cf7cfdf15bb88518ad2fc5951a1cf9f03bb3c4b307471f852dade by three P6 records: evidence/local/P6_LOCAL_REPLAY_CONTRACT_V3.json, REPRODUCE_V3.md and CONTENT_MANIFEST_V2.json. Relocking invalidates all three, and the paper directory also carries a SHA256SUMS whose blast radius could not be verified here without running that paper's full check suite.
the_obvious_fix_and_why_it_was_reverted.decision: Reverted. Leaving three pre-existing failures is better than shipping a cascade through frozen replay records that could not be verified.

what_a_correct_fix_looks_like: run uv lock so pypdf enters the lock
recompute the uv.lock digest and update it in all three P6 records that pin it, plus SHA256SUMS if it covers them
re-run the P6 V3 replay and confirm the four output digests are unchanged -- they should be, since the replay is stdlib plus z3 and pypdf touches none of it
only then declare the extra and wire it into the lanes
note: The P6 replay outputs do not depend on pypdf, so this is bookkeeping rather than a scientific change. It is still a change to a frozen contract's recorded environment, and belongs to whoever owns that contract.
